errors.evidence: The description does not mention the tick interval of the x-axis, which is every 2 years.

errors.text_span: erreicht ein Hoch von fast 1000 im Jahr 1990
errors.evidence: The peak of the TSE line (purple) is in 1991, not 1990.

errors.text_span: bevor sie auf etwa 800 im Jahr 1993 fällt
errors.evidence: The value for the TSE line in 1993 is approximately 840, not 800.

errors.text_span: fällt auf etwa 700 im Jahr 2005 ab
errors.evidence: The value for the TSE line in 2005 is approximately 750, not 700.

errors.text_span: und steigt dann auf über 900 im Jahr 2008 an
errors.evidence: The TSE line does not rise to over 900 in 2008. In 2008, the value is approximately 600. The last major peak was in 2003, at nearly 1000.
The final value of the TSE line in 2017 is approximately 520, not 600.

errors.text_span: bevor sie sich um das Jahr 2000 auf etwa 400 einpendelt
errors.evidence: The blue line (TSEB) does not level off at 400 around the year 2000. In 2000, its value is closer to 480 and it is still rising. It levels off in a higher range (around 400-500) after its peak in 2003.
